# Bundled DOCX dependencies

- `mammoth.browser.min.js`: Mammoth **1.11.0**, from `https://registry.npmjs.org/mammoth/-/mammoth-1.11.0.tgz` (`package/mammoth.browser.min.js`). MIT license: `mammoth.LICENSE`.
- `docx.js`: docx **9.5.1**, from `https://registry.npmjs.org/docx/-/docx-9.5.1.tgz` (`package/dist/index.iife.js`). MIT license: `docx.LICENSE`.

Files are copied unchanged from the published packages and served locally. DOCX import also uses the suite's existing JSZip bundle for archive size checks.
